summary: Official Bangladesh DLRS and Sherpur district land-service routes were found and inspected. The current public DLRS viewer returned Sherpur as a district but returned no survey entries for it; the separate land-zoning viewer omitted Mymensingh from its live division list; configured GeoServer capabilities returned 503. No safe anonymous Sherpur parcel geometry or native identity was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bengali first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-5485-sherpur.json. They found official DLRS map/search, Mouza-map purchase, national land-zoning, and Sherpur district land-service pages, but no public city-bounded parcel feature layer.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GETs and POSTs followed current official JavaScript/configuration. Sherpur district selection succeeded in the DLRS viewer, survey lookup returned an empty array, the land-zoning division list omitted Mymensingh, and two configured GeoServer WMS GetCapabilities requests returned 503. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal submission, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax/account/contact lookup was used.
scopeLimits: Official national and district custodian pages establish a land-record/map route, not a verified open parcel adapter or citywide coverage.
The empty Sherpur survey response was not treated as citywide cadastral absence.
The land-zoning viewer's missing Mymensingh division prevented a Sherpur parcel request through that route; this is a UI/catalog limitation, not evidence that Sherpur has no parcels.
GeoServer 503 responses provide no schema, CRS, geometry, or native identity evidence.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, unavailable UI, or service error was treated as evidence of citywide absence; the WUP point was preserved exactly.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; do not synthesize one from selector values, response order, or internal records.
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retained
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: Restricted, order-based, temporarily unavailable, or unpublished cadastral coverage may exist. Public availability, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, city coverage, and anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
